-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 70. 4x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 70. 3x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 90 seconds.

Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
